metadata.title: Negative-Definite Plumbings and New Unknotting Numbers
metadata.abstract: We use Neumann's normal form to decide whether the double branched cover of a knot bounds a negative-definite plumbing tree in either orientation, starting from the recognised Seifert or graph-manifold structure of the cover. For many non-alternating knots with at most thirteen crossings whose unknotting numbers were unknown, this identifies the cases in which the Heegaard Floer homology of the cover can be computed from such a plumbing, and shows for most of the others that it cannot. We determine 112 new unknotting numbers. For 43 of them, the lower bound rests on Heegaard Floer homology computed from the plumbing; for the other 69, it comes from linking pairings and from a theorem of McCoy and Park on special alternating knots. Finally, we show that the knot 13n1587 is a further explicit counterexample to the Bernhard--Jablan conjecture, after 13n3370.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.workSummary: 用双分支覆盖的 Seifert 或图流形结构判别负定 plumbing 可用性，结合 Heegaard Floer 同调、链接配对及已有定理，确定112个新的解结数。
analysis.breakthrough: 扩充十三交叉以内非交错结的精确解结数，并给出 Bernhard–Jablan 猜想的又一显式反例。
analysis.limitations: 112个值的下界来源不同，其中43个才依赖 plumbing 同调计算，不能全归为同一种方法。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露部分识别覆盖、计算正规形和验证障碍的代码在 Claude Opus 5.5 辅助下编写，由作者承担代码与数学结果责任。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25430v1 · 第19页代码可复现说明

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。作者披露部分识别覆盖、计算正规形和验证障碍的代码在 Claude Opus 5.5 辅助下编写，由作者承担代码与数学结果责任。

analysis.priorityReason: 对结表计算和四维拓扑相关读者实用。
